title: Fluctuations of Discrete-Time Random Walks
summary: These notes are devoted to fluctuations of one-dimensional random walks. We discuss various approaches to first-passage times and to the corresponding conditional distributions. After discussion of some classical methods, such as reflection principle for simple random walks and Wiener-Hopf factorisation, we proceed to the universality approach, which has been developed in recent past. Considering one-dimensional case allows us to avoid some technical obstacles and to present the core of this method in a more transparent way.
